approvers: Owner and the main contractor or client who specifies glazing protection
reason: We already protect glazing with film and tape for next to nothing, and I buy the cheapest option that is good enough. At about €19/m² this is many times what we pay, and we do not outsource this today so it would mean a new budget line and a new supplier.
objection: Film and tape cost almost nothing; why pay about €19/m²? A sprayed coating on coated glass and frames also worries me, as a residue or a mark on the finish would be my problem.
instead: Keep using protection film and tape, applied by our own crew, and buy the cheapest that is good enough.
would_change_my_mind: A main contractor or client specifying it and paying for it separately, plus independent proof it leaves no marks on coated glass and finishes, at a price near film and tape.
